decisions.reason: The individual EARsleeve uses existing digital earmold production at low marginal cost, and demand for universal in-ear systems is still developing, so the option is cheap to keep open.
The vacuum thermoforming unit is core dental equipment with certification already sunk, and nothing in its record points to a weak value, so keeping it costs little.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core offer and its value is highly uncertain, but it is only a year old and the firm can make it with its existing digital production, so it stays open until more results arrive.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing workflow systems and was launched only recently, so dropping it now would forfeit its option value before uncertainty resolves.
